is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae sensu lato and Anopheles gambiae sensu stricto mosquitoes (page 1, 2, 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotype data for Vgsc L995F, N1570Y, A1746S, P1874L, T791M, and Gste2 L119V (Table 2, page 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 provides alternate allele frequencies and total alleles called for resistant, susceptible, and control mosquitoes (page 3).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as larvae from pools on Bubaque island, Bijagós Archipelago, Guinea-Bissau (page 2, 9).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study conducting WHO tube tests and whole genome sequencing on field-collected mosquitoes (page 2, 9).

sub_country_location.evidence: Samples were collected from Bubaque island, Bijagós Archipelago, Guinea-Bissau (page 2, 9).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field collections and bioassays were conducted in November 2022 (page 1, 2, 9).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new collections and phenotypic testing conducted in 2022, distinct from the 2019 collections mentioned in the authors' previous work (page 2, 7).

supplement.evidence: The required genotype counts and allele frequencies are provided in Table 2 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study investigated deltamethrin resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.s. from Bubaque island, Guinea-Bissau, using WHO tube tests and whole genome sequencing. Resistance was confirmed phenotypically, and several resistance-associated SNPs (Vgsc and Gste2) were identified and genotyped in resistant, susceptible, and control mosquitoes.
